title: Zesty Brine-Wet Middle-Eastern Chicken Ti-Leaf Wrap
description: A buttery and pillowy weeknight Middle-Eastern dish featuring ground cardomom, brine-wet, ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly, form=musakhan, vessel=ti-leaf-wrap.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend the onion, ginger, cardomom, cumin, turmeric, salt, black pepper, and cinnamon until smooth.
Heat the ghee or oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the blended spice mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the rice vinegar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Meanwhile, place the ti leaves on a baking sheet and brush with a little oil.
When the chicken mixture is finished cooking, place a portion of it onto the center of each ti leaf.
Fold the leaves over the filling to form a package, and brush with a little more oil.
Bake for 5-7 minutes, or until the leaves are crispy and the filling is hot and bubbly.
